questions.q: In the video, the radius of the circle is 5 cm. What is the diameter?
questions.why: The diameter is twice the radius, so 2 × 5 = 10 cm.

questions.q: Which formula correctly shows the relationship between diameter and radius?
questions.why: The script says diameter equals two times radius.

questions.q: The diameter of a circle is 12 cm. What is its radius?
questions.why: Radius equals diameter divided by two, so 12 / 2 = 6 cm.
